name: Casting and the Bite
description: Hold to cast, wait for the bite, then hit the timing bar.

pages.title: Casting and the Bite
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Hold** use to charge a cast, release to throw. Longer hold, longer cast.
- On a bite, **right-click** to start reeling.
- A bar appears: right-click while the marker is in the coloured zone.
- Miss and the fish gets away.

**Casting.** Hold use with a rod: a bar fills over about a second. Let go to throw; a full bar throws furthest.\
\
**The bite.** The bobber dips with a splash. You have a second or two to right-click. Junk, treasure and crates reel straight in; a fish starts the timing game.

**The timing game.** A bar shows over your crosshair with a coloured zone in the middle and a marker sweeping across it. Right-click while the marker is inside the zone.

- Inside: **Good**, the fish is yours.
- Dead centre: **Perfect Catch!** and more experience.
- Outside: **Miss**, the fish escapes.

Each fish moves the marker its own way: smooth swings, pauses, jitters or sudden darts. Strong fish have a narrow zone, fast fish a fast marker.\
\
If you never click, the fish gives up after a few seconds and your line stays in the water. A miss costs a point of rod durability but no bait.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Open water** is a 5x5 patch of water at least two blocks deep with open air above it around the bobber. Surface crates and the best treasure only come from open water; fish don't care.\
\
Rain on the bobber, or fishing under a roof, makes bites come a little faster in water.

Each bite rolls a fish, junk, treasure or a crate. Luck (Luck of the Sea, lucky bait, some rods and lines) moves the roll from junk toward treasure and rare fish. Lure and bait speed make bites come sooner.\
\
Operators can see the odds where they stand: cast, then type `/fishing test fish` (or `loot`, `crate`).
